name: Can water-damaged drywall be patched immediately after a leak?

mainEntity.name: Can water-damaged drywall be patched immediately after a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your drywall damage came from a burst pipe, roof leak, or storm event, the underlying leak must be permanently fixed and the wall cavity dried out before patching starts. Trapping moisture inside the wall studs behind fresh compound leads to peeling tape, crumbling gypsum, and hidden mold growth. A contractor checks the wood framing and insulation behind the opening to ensure moisture readings are normal, then installs fresh drywall backing before sealing and texturing the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: No. The leak must be repaired and the interior wall cavity completely dried out first to prevent structural deterioration and hidden mold growth behind the new patch.
